Create a pull request on GitHub.

Usage:
  gh pr create [flags]

Flags:
  -t, --title string        Title of the pull request
  -b, --body string         Body of the pull request
      --draft               Mark the pull request as a draft
  -l, --label name          Add labels (can be used multiple times)
  -j, --jobs int            Maximum jobs to run in parallel

Global Flags:
  -R, --repo <[HOST/]OWNER/REPO>   Select another repository
      --verbose                    Enable verbose output

See 'gh help pr create' for more information.
